episodes.synopsis: Julius, the son of Gaius, attempts to reclaim his former territory of Van from Souma, backed by the authority of the Gran Chaos Empire. The power to negotiate is given to Jeanne Euphoria, younger sister of Empress Maria Euphoria.
episodes.title: Amidonia in a Lion's Skin

episodes.synopsis: Jeanne's negotiations continue. These negotiations are no longer in the hands of Julius, but wholly a matter for the Gran Chaos Empire and the Kingdom of Elfrieden. Further, Jeanne sees a new future and a new world in Souma.
episodes.title: Becoming Good Friends Who Never Offend

episodes.synopsis: Van is returned to Julius as a result of the mediation of the Grand Chaos Empire, in exchange for a great deal of reparation costs. Souma returns to the Kingdom of Elfrieden, where many other problems yet remain.
episodes.title: Tyranny Is More Terrible than Tigers

episodes.synopsis: Souma is victorious in both the Elfrieden civil war and the battle against Amidonia. However, his victory was won as a result of the devotion of a man named Georg. Still, the law is the law, and Souma must pass down a harsh judgment against Georg.
episodes.title: A Warrior Will Die for One Who Understands Him

episodes.synopsis: Weathering a number of problems, Souma more or less finishes dealing with the aftermath of the war. However, he was set upon by an inexplicable anxiety, the distress and pressure only felt by those in authority. It was not something he could bear alone.
episodes.title: Seeing Snake Shadows in Every Cup

episodes.synopsis: Royal Guard Captain Ludwin's childhood friend, Genia, was a rare breed of mad scientist. Her inventions leave even Souma, who comes from a world of science and technology, in astonishment... In addition to being utterly dumbfounded.
episodes.title: Strike While the Iron Is Hot

episodes.synopsis: With Van, the capital of Amidonia, returned to Julius, so too returns the oppressive rule of the government. The people's dissatisfaction increases day by day, until finally they end up revolting. Julius's sister, Roroa, then comes before Souma.
episodes.title: Aping the Frown of Beauty

episodes.synopsis: Roroa's arrival further complicates the situation between Amidonia and the Kingdom of Elfrieden. It was an outcome not even Souma had anticipated. In response, a conference between Grand Chaos Empire Empress Maria Euphoria and Souma must be convened.
episodes.title: Using Shrimp as Bait to Catch Sea Bream, but Instead Catching a Shark

episodes.synopsis: An unusual Friedonian slave trader named Ginger Camus gave his slaves clean clothes and enough to eat, as well as providing them with an education, little knowing that this would eventually end up rocking the kingdom.
episodes.title: Those Without Wisdom Are Fools

episodes.synopsis: Refugees are one of modern society's great challenges, and the Kingdom of Friedonia is no exception. Refugees who had been driven from their lands by invading monsters have gathered outside the walls of the capital and started an encampment.
episodes.title: Gargling and Hand Washing Are the Basis of Disease Prevention

episodes.synopsis: Souma and the others visit the refugees, where they help an expectant mother with a difficult delivery. The newborn life provides hope and a foundation for the future to the refugees, but not all of them accept the future Souma presents them.
episodes.title: Away from My Hometown for So Many Years

episodes.synopsis: One evening, Excel whispers to the fiancées Liscia, Aisha, Juna, and Roroa that she will teach them how to please their man, and suddenly commences a "Fiancées' Bridal Course". The secrets of Souma and his fiancées are about to come to light.
episodes.title: Know Your Enemy and Know Yourself, and Your Union Shall Not Be Endangered

episodes.synopsis: On New Year's Eve, Souma is summoned by his predecessor, King Albert, to talk with his wife, Elisha. The amazing truth told by Albert's mouth. And what's up in Souma's chest when he knows "everything"...
episodes.title: Ahead, I See No Ancestors; Behind, I Find No Followers
